# Handoff Acknowledged

## Summary Assessment

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

**Champion holds** — better tuning consistency and drawdown control. The PASS candidate shows improved lockbox minimum (more robust OOS floor), but the tuning minimum of 0.051 signals fold instability that outweighs the benefit.

## Observations
- **130 loops in ~14h** → healthy throughput (~9 loops/hr)
- **No INCONCLUSIVE** currently queued — clean state
- **~34h runway** remaining for exploration

## Recommended Actions
Execute the suggested commands in sequence:

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

No manual intervention required. System operating nominally.
